title: AI as Analyst
scenario: An AI analyst has produced a confident assessment containing both correct and incorrect conclusions.
objective: Review every material claim, accept or reject it with evidence, and document at least two incorrect/incomplete AI conclusions.
ai_native_dimension: This mission makes AI fallibility explicit. The learner must use evidence to challenge the model.

verification.message: at least two claims must be rejected
review decisions must cite evidence IDs

aar_questions: What was the security problem in AI as Analyst and what objective evidence proved it?
What was the risk if it remained unresolved?
What did you change and why?
How did you verify the result independently of AI output?
Where did AI help, where was it wrong/incomplete, and what remained your responsibility?
